_comment: Composite indexes the shop's queries need.
Firestore creates single-field indexes on its own, but a query that filters
on one field and sorts on another needs a composite index declared here. The
customer's order list does exactly that (userId == me, newest first), and
without the index it does not return an empty list — it throws, and the
customer sees a dashboard with no orders at all.
These already exist on the current database (verified against it directly).
